name: CHIRPSTACK SETTINGS - IMPORTANT: Read this!
info:
=== WHERE TO EDIT CHIRPSTACK CONFIG ===

The global-config node is NOT visible on this canvas!
It does not matter how much you scroll - you will not find it here.

HOW TO FIND IT:
  1. Menu (☰, top right corner of Node-RED)
  2. Click 'Configuration Nodes'
  3. Double-click 'global-config' (id: dcd6abce8967b75f)
  4. Edit LORALARM_CS_API and LORALARM_CS_API_TOKEN
  5. Click 'Deploy'

WHAT TO SET:
  LORALARM_CS_API       = 192.168.2.26:8080 (your ChirpStack server, NOT localhost!)
  LORALARM_CS_API_TOKEN = your JWT API token from ChirpStack (API Keys page)

WARNING:
  Every flow import (sensor flows etc.) OVERWRITES these values!
  After ANY flow import, re-check:
  Menu -> Configuration Nodes -> global-config

Downlink fails with 'Enqueue error' if these are wrong.
Click 'Test ChirpStack' button below to verify after editing.

Download log files
info:
HTTP endpoints: GET /download/log_tx.csv and GET /download/log_alarms.csv
Flow: http in (/download/:filename) -> 'validate filename' (whitelist; builds
msg.filename from the LORALARM_LOG_TX / LORALARM_LOG_ALARMS env vars; unknown names -> 404 straight to http
response) -> file in (reads msg.filename) -> 'set download headers' (200 with
text/csv and Content-Disposition attachment, or 404 when the file is missing)
-> http response.
The monthly job above deletes the same files, so download them before month end.

Create log directory at startup
info:
mkdir -p on the directories of LORALARM_LOG_ALARMS / LORALARM_LOG_TX,
so the sensor flows' `file` nodes (createDir off) can append from the
first message. mkdir -p is a no-op when the directory already exists.
Runs once 0.1 s after deploy. The Node-RED user needs write access to
the parent directory (e.g. /var/log); if Node-RED runs as an
unprivileged system user, create it once instead:
  sudo mkdir -p /var/log/loralarm
  sudo chown node-red:node-red /var/log/loralarm
